L3: This chapter and the next describe the object file information and system actions that create running programs. Some information here applies to all systems; information specific to one processor resides in sections marked accordingly.
L4: Executable and shared object files statically represent programs. To execute such programs, the system uses the files to create dynamic program representations, or process images. L7:   * Program Header. The program header complements the Section Header Table (cite2†Chapter 3, Sections ), describing object file structures that relate directly to program execution. L9:   * Program Loading. Given an object file, the system must load it into memory for the program to run.
